afterSource: Scoped runtime sources in this PR; production release builds with no test-hooks
platform: Windows ARM64; x64 and i686 native tests ran under Windows-on-ARM emulation, not physical x64/i686 hardware
observer: Separate ARM64 PowerShell K32EnumProcessModulesEx/K32GetModuleFileNameExW, child-reported PID and stdin/stdout handshake; no observer code injected into Node/Python

regressions.name: ARM64 scoped native behavior
regressions.command: cargo test --locked --offline -p dynwinrt --lib -- system_helpers com::gdi_cleanup_tests dispatcher_queue::core_messaging xaml_application::tests::enables_per_monitor_v2

regressions.name: x64 scoped native behavior (Windows ARM emulation)
regressions.command: cargo test --locked --offline -p dynwinrt --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --lib -- system_helpers com::gdi_cleanup_tests dispatcher_queue::core_messaging xaml_application::tests::enables_per_monitor_v2
